videos.title: What is Albedo?
videos.watchFor: Distinguish reflected energy from absorbed energy. Albedo is a fraction, not energy created by a surface.

videos.title: BEHIND THE SCIENCE 2012 | Chemosynthesis
videos.watchFor: Separate the chemical energy source from the carbon source. Different sulfur pathways have different products.

videos.title: Decomposers Role in the Ecosystem
videos.watchFor: Follow the recycling of matter; energy is transferred and dissipated, not recycled.

videos.title: The 10 Percent Rule
videos.watchFor: Treat 10% as an illustrative assumption, not a universal efficiency. Use the measured values in our worked example.

videos.title: Ecosystem Ecology: Links in the Chain - Crash Course Ecology #7
videos.watchFor: Follow the direction of matter and energy transfer. Identify the boundary of each efficiency calculation.

videos.title: Biomagnification and the Trouble with Toxins
videos.watchFor: Distinguish buildup within one organism from increasing concentration across trophic levels.

videos.title: Food Webs and Energy Pyramids: Bedrocks of Biodiversity
videos.watchFor: Check what the pyramid measures: numbers, standing biomass or energy per unit time.

videos.title: The water (hydrologic) cycle
videos.watchFor: Separate transfers within the chosen boundary from inputs and outputs across it.

videos.title: Describe Nitrogen Cycle-Nitrogen cycle in simple terms
videos.watchFor: Name fixation, nitrification, assimilation and denitrification separately. Plants can absorb nitrate and ammonium.

videos.title: Sulfur Cycle
videos.watchFor: Distinguish sulfur reservoirs, biological transformations and human emissions.

videos.title: Eutrophication Explained
videos.watchFor: Trace nutrient input to growth, decomposition and oxygen consumption; nutrient enrichment does not by itself prove one cause.

videos.title: Stromatolites
videos.watchFor: Distinguish observations of layered structures from an inference about their biological origin.

videos.title: History of Oxygen
videos.watchFor: Distinguish local oxygen production from the much longer change in atmospheric oxygen.

videos.title: The Hydrologic and Carbon Cycles: Always Recycle! - Crash Course Ecology #8
videos.watchFor: Connect water transfers and carbon cycling without treating the two as the same process.

videos.title: Nitrogen & Phosphorus Cycles: Always Recycle! Part 2 - Crash Course Ecology #9
videos.watchFor: Compare nitrogen transformations with phosphorus transport and weathering.

videos.title: Ecology Review: Food Chains & Webs, Relationships, Nitrogen & Carbon Cycles, Effects on Biodiversity
videos.watchFor: Review feeding relationships and nutrient cycles, and state a limit on each model.
